post.description: Submits a new query job and streams its results back as Server-Sent Events (SSE) in the same response while the job runs. If the client disconnects before the query job terminates, the job's cancellation is requested.

200.description:
The API server streams query results using Server-Sent Events. The schema describes the `data` field of each event.

- `job` is the first event. Its `StreamingQueryJobEvent` payload identifies the query job.
- Each unnamed event carries one result in a `StreamingQueryResultEvent` payload. Results from different archives can arrive in any order.
- `end` closes the stream and reports the job's terminal status in a `StreamingQueryEndEvent` payload. If the job failed, the status is `Failed`.
- `error` closes the stream in place of `end` if the API server encounters an error after job submission, such as a failure to read the job's status. The `StreamingQueryErrorEvent` payload reports the server error. The server requests cancellation, but the job may still be running when you receive the event.

400.description: The request body is not valid JSON or could not be read.

413.description: The request body exceeds the configured size limit.

415.description: The Content-Type header is missing or is not a JSON media type.

422.description: The JSON body has missing or unknown fields (including `output`, which only `POST /query` takes), or fields with invalid types or values (e.g., an empty `query.datasets` or `query.query_string`, or a `query.time_range` whose begin timestamp exceeds its end timestamp).

get.description: Streams the results of a previously submitted query as Server-Sent Events (SSE).

parameters.name: raw_docs
parameters.description:
When `true`, each SSE event contains the raw result document from the results cache
serialized as JSON (including metadata such as the timestamp and the original file path);
otherwise, each event contains only the log message. Only applies to query jobs whose
results are buffered in `MongoDB`.

parameters.name: sorted

200.description: Server-Sent Events stream of query results. Each event contains a single line of the query result in JSON format.

400.description: The query job ID or query parameters are invalid.

404.description: No query job with the given ID was found.

409.description: The query job streamed its results to a network listener, so they aren't stored.

get.description: Streams committed timeline buckets as Server-Sent Events (SSE).

200.description: Each event contains one timeline bucket in JSON format.

400.description: The query job ID is invalid or the job has no timeline configuration.

404.description: No query job with the given ID was found.

get.description: Gets resource usage statistics for compression jobs within the given time range.

parameters.name: time_range_begin_millisecs
parameters.description: Start of usage window (epoch milliseconds, inclusive).

parameters.name: time_range_end_millisecs
parameters.description: End of usage window (epoch milliseconds, exclusive).

parameters.name: job_status
parameters.description:
Job statuses to include as a comma-separated list (e.g. `job_status=succeeded,failed`).
Recognized values (case-insensitive): `PENDING`, `RUNNING`, `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`. Defaults
to `SUCCEEDED,FAILED` (all terminal states).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of jobs to return. Must be > 0; defaults to 1000.

400.description: Invalid query parameters (e.g., time_range_begin_millisecs > time_range_end_millisecs, missing required fields)

oneOf.description: Counts the matching log events in each time bucket of the given width.

bucket_size_millisecs.description: The width of each time bucket, in milliseconds.

Aggregation.description: An aggregation over a query job's results.

CompressionUsage.description: Resource usage statistics for the compression job with the specified ID.

compressed_size_bytes.description: Total compressed archive size, in bytes.

duration_secs.description: Wall-clock duration the job ran, in seconds. Absent if the job did not complete.

num_tasks.description: Number of tasks the job was split into.

tasks_duration_secs.description: Sum of all task durations, in seconds. Absent if no tasks reported a duration.

time_begin_millisecs.description: Time the job started executing (epoch milliseconds).

time_creation_millisecs.description: Time the job was created (epoch milliseconds).

uncompressed_size_bytes.description: Total uncompressed size of input files, in bytes.
